why: Declare Bonebreaker Giant as attacker. The two Goblin Tokens have summoning sickness and cannot attack this turn. The Giant deals 4 damage if unblocked (bringing opponent to 5 life). If they block, I trade the Giant but clear a threat. On their turn, they'll attack with Rumbling Baloth (4) + Grizzly Bears (2) = 6 damage. I can block with my Goblin tokens to reduce incoming damage and potentially survive one more turn, but this remains a heavily losing position. I'm now in topdeck mode hoping to draw a miracle card that can close the game or stabilize (though unlikely).
